intro: Senegal is a presidential democracy with regular peaceful elections.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for five years and appoints the prime minister. The National Assembly has 165 seats. President Faye and Prime Minister Ousmane Sonko promised to fight corruption.

chapters.title: Casamance
text: A separatist conflict in Casamance has mostly calmed down since the 2010s.

keyTerms.meaning: Government chosen by the people in elections.
